UNIVERSITY INSTITUTE OF ENGINEERING AND TECHNOLOGY (UIET)
PANJAB UNIVERSITY, CHANDIGARH – 160014, INDIA
Advertisement Number: 31468/UIET Dated: 1-08-2025
ADVERTISEMENT FOR TWO FULL-TIME PhD FELLOWSHIPS
Under Visvesvaraya PhD Scheme for Electronics & IT – Phase II
(Sanctioned by Digital India Corporation, MeitY, Government of India)
Applications are invited for Two Full-Time PhD fellowships under the Visvesvaraya PhD
Scheme – Phase II, funded by the Digital India Corporation (DIC), MeitY, Govt. of India, for
Academic Year 2025–26. Last Date to Apply: 18-08-2025
Important: These fellowships are strictly limited to candidates making fresh applications to PhD programs
in the following branches of UIET, Panjab University:
● Computer Science and Engineering (CSE)
● Information Technology (IT)
● Electronics and Communication Engineering (ECE)
Financial Support for Full-Time PhD Fellows:
● ₹38,750/month in 1st & 2nd year; ₹43,750/month in 3rd to 5th year (or until PhD completion,
whichever is earlier)
● Reimbursement of Rent (RoR) as per GoI city classification (24%/16%/8%)
● ₹1.20 lakh/year Research Contingency
● Up to ₹1.5 lakh support for International Conferences (from 3rd year)
● Optional Visit to Labs Abroad (6 months, with ₹1.5 lakh/month + travel)
Eligibility Criteria:
● Must fulfill Panjab University PhD admission norms available at
https://rdc.puchd.ac.in/show-noticeboard.php?nbid=30
● Must be a fresh applicant for PhD admission in UIET (CSE/IT/ECE) for AY 2025–26
● Must not have availed or be availing any other Central/State fellowship
● Must secure written consent from a UIET faculty supervisor from eligible branches
● Inter-departmental or institutional transfers are not permitted under this scheme
Application Procedure:
● Contact an eligible supervisor in UIET (CSE/IT/ECE) and obtain consent
● Apply online via: 🔗 https://forms.gle/JPEHR7YS49wssZ4Q7
Important Dates:
● Application Opens: 1-08-2025
● Last Date to Apply: 18-08-2025
For More Information, Visit:https://jobs.puchd.ac.in/list-jobs.php https://uiet.puchd.ac.in/?page_id=3175
For any Queries please contact : Prof.(Dr.) Mamta Juneja, Nodal Officer, Visvesvaraya PhD Scheme
